periods.method: Chronological split of the trading days: the first 60% in-sample, the next 20% validation, the last 20% out-of-sample. Trades are assigned to the segment in which they exited. Walk-forward folds are consecutive equal blocks used to check whether results are consistent over time.

definitions.ending_equity: Cash plus open positions valued at their last price, at the end of the test (USD).
definitions.net_pnl: Ending equity minus starting capital: the overall result after all costs (USD).
definitions.total_return_pct: Net P&L as a percentage of starting capital.
definitions.realized_pnl: Profit or loss locked in by sales during the test, after commissions (USD).
definitions.unrealized_pnl: Paper profit or loss on positions still open at the end, at their last price (USD).
definitions.gross_profits: Sum of the net results of all winning completed trades (USD).
definitions.gross_losses: Sum of the net results of all losing completed trades (USD, shown negative).
definitions.completed_trades: Round trips that were fully closed during the test. A position sold in pieces counts once.
definitions.open_positions_end: Positions still held when the test ended.
definitions.winning_trades: Completed trades with a net result above zero.
definitions.losing_trades: Completed trades with a net result below zero.
definitions.breakeven_trades: Completed trades with a net result of exactly zero (to the cent).
definitions.win_rate_pct: Winning trades as a percentage of completed trades.
definitions.avg_win: Average net result of the winning trades (USD).
definitions.avg_loss: Average net result of the losing trades (USD).
definitions.profit_factor: Gross profits divided by the absolute value of gross losses. Above 1 means winners outweighed losers.
definitions.expectancy: Average net result per completed trade (USD).
definitions.avg_r: Average result per trade in R, where 1R is the money that would have been lost at the initial stop.
definitions.max_drawdown_pct: Largest percentage fall in equity from a previous peak, measured every 5 minutes.
definitions.max_drawdown_usd: The same largest fall, in dollars.
definitions.avg_holding_minutes: Average time between the first entry fill and the final exit (minutes).
definitions.total_commission: All simulated commissions (IBKR Fixed pricing model, USD).
definitions.total_slippage: Estimated cost of spread and slippage, already included in the fill prices (USD).
definitions.cost_share_of_gross_pct: Commissions plus slippage as a percentage of the absolute gross (pre-cost) P&L.
definitions.avg_exposure_pct: Average value of open positions as a percentage of equity, across all 5-minute marks.
definitions.max_exposure_pct: Highest value of open positions as a percentage of equity.
definitions.time_in_market_pct: Share of 5-minute marks with at least one open position.
definitions.max_concurrent_positions: Most positions held at the same time.
definitions.max_consecutive_losses: Longest run of losing completed trades in a row.
definitions.top3_share_of_net_pct: Net P&L of the three best trades as a percentage of total net P&L (shows dependence on a few trades).
definitions.daily_volatility_pct: Standard deviation of daily returns (percent of the day's starting equity).
definitions.sharpe_like: Average daily return divided by its standard deviation, times the square root of 252. A rough risk-adjusted figure; not reliable on short samples.
definitions.benchmark_return_pct: Buy-and-hold return of the benchmark ETF over the same days (first open to last close).
definitions.mean_trade_ci95: Range that would contain the average trade result in 95% of bootstrap resamples of the trades. If it includes 0, the average could plausibly be zero.
definitions.days_with_trades: Trading days on which at least one trade was completed.
definitions.days_without_trades: Trading days with data but no completed trade.

summary: What it does: Equities Mean Reversion (Intraday index ETF scalps on VWAP deviations) trades 1m signals, flat every day. Entries between 10:00 and 15:30 New York time need every check to pass (V1); the initial stop is sigma_below_entry(sigma=1.5); exits: target_vwap, time_stop(minutes=30), force_close.
Period tested: 2026-06-22 to 2026-10-20 (85 trading days; requested 2026-06-22 to 2026-10-20).
Data: ibkr, 3 of 3 symbols had daily data; 255 symbol-days of 1m bars were used; data status: pass.
Simulated trades: 213 completed, 0 still open at the end.
Measured result: net P&L -$5,986.33 (-0.60% of $1,000,000.00 starting capital), win rate 29.6% of completed trades, profit factor 0.321.
Largest decline: 0.61% ($6,093.53) from a previous equity peak.
Costs: included. Commissions $426.00; estimated spread and slippage $5,018.13 are built into the fill prices.
Unseen data: the last part of the period was kept as an out-of-sample check: 5 trades, -$177.05.

computed_findings: Over this period the simulation produced 213 completed trades and a net result of -$5,986.33 after costs.
The bootstrap range of the average trade (-$36.33 to -$19.89) does not include zero in this sample.
concerns: Does the data cover enough market history and conditions? 85 trading days (2026-06-22 to 2026-10-20), provider ibkr, data status pass, 0 symbol-days without 5-minute data.
Are transaction costs a material part of the result? Commissions $426.00 and estimated spread/slippage $5,018.13 = 97.9% of the absolute gross P&L.

Does performance vary a lot between periods (market regimes)? 0 of 3 consecutive periods were profitable: 2026-06-22..2026-07-30: -$2,557.24, 2026-07-31..2026-09-09: -$2,097.41, 2026-09-10..2026-10-20: -$1,331.68.
not_established: That the strategy will be profitable in the future: historical simulation results do not guarantee future performance.
That live fills would match the simulated fills (no historical bid/ask; fills are modelled).
That the result is statistically significant: no significance test is claimed here.
assumptions: Quote proxy: ask/bid = last close +/- 2.0 bps; extra slippage 2.0 bps on market-like fills.
Ambiguous bars: when a stop and a profit target could both have been reached in one bar, the stop is assumed first (conservative).

Timing: an order can fill only in bars that start after it was sent (a pass at 10:05:03 fills from the 10:10 bar; a force close sent at 15:51 on 5-minute bars sells at the 15:55 open). A stop raised during a bar applies from the next bar. The bot replaces an unfilled exit at the next pass, so an exit in practice fills at the next bar's open or not at all (pessimistic for exits a live order would have filled within its first minutes).
Buying power: cash x 1.0 (the paper account's margin may allow more).
Universe: today's index members from the fallback list, so stocks that left the index are missing (survivorship bias, usually flattering).
assessment.data_sufficiency: 85 trading days and 213 trades. This is not enough data for a reliable evaluation; treat every figure as illustrative.
assessment.costs_and_execution: No execution stress test was run.
further_tests: Test at least one full year, including a falling market, before relying on any result.
Compare with the stress run below and with actual paper-trading fills.
Look at what the market did in the losing periods (trend, volatility).
assessment.label: Automated interpretation: generated by fixed rules from the metrics and validation results above. It is not investment advice and not a statistical test.

rules_explained.label: Strategy
rules_explained.explanation: Intraday index ETF scalps on VWAP deviations

rules_explained.label: Timeframe
rules_explained.explanation: Signals use completed 1m bars.

rules_explained.label: Holding period
rules_explained.explanation: Flat by the end of every day.

rules_explained.label: Universe
rules_explained.explanation: These symbols are scanned.

rules_explained.label: First entry time
rules_explained.explanation: No entries before 10:00 New York time.

rules_explained.label: Last entry time
rules_explained.explanation: No new entries after 15:30; unfilled entry orders expire a minute later.

rules_explained.label: Force close
rules_explained.explanation: Everything still open is sold from 15:50.

rules_explained.label: Entry check V1
rules_explained.explanation: The last completed close is at or below today's VWAP minus `sigma` volume-weighted standard deviations (a stretch below fair value). Stores vwap/sd in the result.

rules_explained.label: Initial stop
rules_explained.explanation: `sigma` x today's VWAP standard deviation below the last completed close.

rules_explained.label: Exit
rules_explained.explanation: Exit when the live price is back at or above today's VWAP (the mean).

rules_explained.label: Exit
rules_explained.explanation: Exit after `days` trading days held (multi-day) or `minutes` (intraday), from at_et on if given. Exactly one of days / minutes.

rules_explained.label: Exit
rules_explained.explanation: Flatten every position from time_filter.force_close_et until the close, with a marketable limit SELL in the protective stop's OCA group, re-priced each pass.

rules_explained.label: Entries per symbol per day
rules_explained.explanation: How often the same symbol may be entered in one day.

rules_explained.label: Risk per trade
rules_explained.explanation: At most 0.5% of the account can be lost if the initial stop is hit.

rules_explained.label: Position size
rules_explained.explanation: One position is at most 10% of the account.

rules_explained.label: Concurrent positions
rules_explained.explanation: At most 2 positions (including unfilled entries) at once.

rules_explained.label: Commission check
rules_explained.explanation: A trade is skipped if its estimated commissions exceed 5.0% of the money at risk.

rules_explained.label: Drawdown breaker
rules_explained.explanation: After a $6,000 fall in cumulative P&L, entries stop until someone re-arms the breaker by hand.

rules_explained.label: Share cap
rules_explained.explanation: One entry order is at most 500 shares.

rules_explained.label: Order value cap
rules_explained.explanation: One entry order is at most $30,000.

rules_explained.label: Entries per day
rules_explained.explanation: At most 5 entry orders per day.

rules_explained.label: Working orders
rules_explained.explanation: At most 2 unfilled entry/exit orders at once (stops not counted).

rules_explained.label: Daily loss halt
rules_explained.explanation: After losing $2,000 in a day, no new entries that day.
